description.value:
Frequency once per day

Cost 2 Vitae

Duration 1 hour

You gain a pair of grafted extra arms. For the duration you may apply a healing Graft as a single action instead of its normal cast time, once per round, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to Treat Wounds. The arms are visible, and they do not retract until the hour is up.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation. Both the action-cost-reduction clause and the +2 Medicine circumstance bonus are gated behind an hour-long activation with no companion effect card.
